# City of Clarkston

> > Official website for the City of Clarkston, Washington, providing municipal services, government information, and community resources.

The City of Clarkston serves residents with essential city services including police and fire departments, city council governance, employment opportunities, and emergency services training. Located in Washington State, the city maintains transparency through regular council meetings and public engagement.

## Key Topics

- City of Clarkston
- Clarkston City Hall
- City Council Meetings
- Municipal Government
- Clarkston Police Department
- Fire Department Services
- Employment and Job Openings
- CPR and Emergency Training
- Washington State
- Public Safety Services
- Civil Service Positions
- Community Services
- American Heart Association
- American Red Cross

## City Government & Services

- [Employment Opportunities](https://clarkston-wa.com/government/employment): Current job openings with the City of Clarkston including police officer and firefighter positions

## Emergency Services & Public Safety

- [CPR Training](https://clarkston-wa.com/departments/fire-department/cpr-training): Cardiopulmonary resuscitation training resources through American Heart Association, American Red Cross, and local partners
